purpose: Representative, source-validated evidence of pedagogical quality, continuity and disciplinary breadth across the history of the Bécsi Magyar Iskola. This is not an exhaustive 40-year staff register and must not be used to infer continuous employment for every person listed.

institutionalClaim.claim: Across its history, BMI has repeatedly worked with qualified teachers, educators, academic specialists and program leaders in Hungarian-language education, bilingualism, inclusive pedagogy, culture, arts, movement, music and newer digital/project-based learning.
institutionalClaim.limits: Quality is evidenced through documented qualifications, pedagogical responsibility, long-term continuity, academic involvement and external coverage; this is not a numerical ranking of teachers or schools.

safetyRules.nonExhaustive: Do not present this registry as a complete list of everyone who taught at BMI since 1987.
safetyRules.employment: Teaching, coordination, advisory or program activity does not by itself establish employment status.
safetyRules.credential: Only assert regulated credentials when explicitly supported by a canonical profile or qualified source.
safetyRules.quality: Use evidence-based wording such as qualified, experienced, pedagogically diverse or academically supported; avoid unsupported superlatives such as best or elite.
